summary: dcrapis 与 VitalikButerin 发表 ZK API 使用额度方案，让用户为 LLM 等高频服务付费而不暴露身份、也不必每次上链。ERC-8004 Agent 身份、信誉与验证标准上线以太坊主网。lightclient 放宽 EIP-8141 APPROVE 要求的 PR 合并。

items.topic: 隐私：ZK API 使用额度
items.title: ethresear.ch：ZK API 使用额度，LLM 及更多
items.note: （dcrapis 与 VitalikButerin）20:34：API 计量难以同时兼顾隐私、安全与效率；Web2 认证把每次请求与真实身份挂钩，每次请求都上链付费又慢又贵且难以隐藏交易图谱，方案用零知识证明的预付额度解决。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: ZK API Usage Credits, LLMs and Beyond
items.note_en: (dcrapis and VitalikButerin), 20:34: API metering struggles to be private, secure and efficient at once; Web2 auth ties each request to a real identity, and paying onchain per request is slow, costly and exposes the transaction graph, so the design uses zero knowledge prepaid credits.

summary_en: dcrapis and VitalikButerin published ZK API usage credits, letting users pay for high frequency services such as LLMs without revealing identity or sending a transaction per request. The ERC-8004 agent identity, reputation and verification standard went live on Ethereum mainnet. lightclient's PR relaxing EIP-8141's APPROVE rule merged.
